events.region: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 65 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects and make
travel difficult. Light snow could lead to areas of blowing snow,
reducing visibility at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Following strong southerly winds north of
Trims Camp today, moderate to heavy snow is expected to build in
today through Wednesday over Isabel Pass. Winds will shift to being
out of the north on Tuesday. This Wind Advisory will be immediately
followed by a Winter Storm Warning that is currently in effect as
snow rates become heavier.
